response.text:
Pricing | Screen Sharing | CrankWheel - CrankWheel

###### Add team members to upgrade to trial of Team any time.

###### Reverts to a limited free plan if no paid plan selected before end of trial.

- Solo
- Team
- Enterprise

One user, unlimited usage, all standard features.

Unlimited users, 100 meetings per month (stack for more), team features.

Enterprise features and usage limits tailored to your organization.

| | Solo | Team | Enterprise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | One user, unlimited usage, all standard features. | Unlimited users, 100 meetings per month (stack for more), team features. | Enterprise features and usage limits tailored to you. |
| | Free trial | Free trial | Talk to sales |
| Price | $29 /month | starts at $99 /month | starts at $XXK /year |
| Included usage | | | |
| User licenses info User accounts are named and can not be shared. Team plans and up are priced based on usage to most closely match the value you receive. | 1 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Meetings per month info A meeting is counted every time you host a meeting with a viewer for 40+ seconds, or you create a share link or segment for one of your recordings, or if you call a prospect in an Instant Demo session. Usage limits reset every month on your signup date. | Unlimited | starting at 100 shared total | custom |
| Features | | | |
| Screen Sharing info You can screen share your full screen, an application window, or just a particular browser tab to virtually any number of viewers, easily. more details | check up to 30 viewers | check up to 100 viewers | check up to 1000s of viewers |
| Video Conferencing info You can use Screen Sharing stand-alone as an add-on to a phone call, or you can schedule full-fledged web conferences where all participants join using their computer microphone, speakers and webcam. | check up to 10 participants | check up to 25 participants | check up to 50 participants |
| Remote Control for sales and customer success info When screen sharing to a single viewer, you can grant them remote control over your mouse and keyboard, for part or all of your screen or a browser tab. No download is required for your viewer, but for presenters this feature requires Windows or macOS. more details | check | check | check |
| Record meetings or screencasts info Record your meetings along with presenter-side audio, or create a screencast video. Recordings are stored in our cloud for a retention period and can be downloaded to your local computer. more details | check 6 month retention | check 6 month retention | check custom retention |
| Projector for HQ video & audio playback in meetings info Play any recording or uploaded video in your account back within a meeting, in full quality along with audio. No jitters or pauses, as CrankWheel implements a separate video-streaming mode optimized for pre-recorded video. Or if you prefer, share tab audio to play any video or audio you come across online, into the meeting. | check | check | check |
| Send personalized sales videos by email info Share personalized recordings or screencasts with your prospects as a link, or by email with an animated preview. Create segments and track playbacks. more details | check | check | check |
| Instant Demos lead capture with instant callbacks info A customizable lead capture widget for your website, that hunts down an agent to call the prospect right away if agents are available. Customize with your branding, ask whatever questions you want, use in email campaigns in addition to your website. Leads can flow through integrations to your CRM. more details | check | check | check |
| Never Over Limits™️ for your peace of mind info We never want to block you from hosting a meeting, creating or sharing a recording or screencast or accepting an Instant Demo request, without giving fair warning. When you run into usage-based limits, you can use one of your Never Over Limits™️ tokens to unblock usage for a full working day. This gives you flexibility to meet a one-time spike, and time to decide whether you prefer to stay on your current plan or upgrade. | N/A | 14 tokens | custom |
| Customize for your company | | | |
| Public link info To easily connect viewers to a screen share you can direct them to a custom URL, such as meeting.is/EXAMPLE, where they can request access to your screen share. | minimum 7 characters | minimum 7 characters | short as you like |
| Upload company logo | check | check | check |
| Branded meeting links info The link viewers type in to connect to your screen share can point to your own website. On the Enterprise plan, this can be done using a CNAME. | check | check | enhanced |
| Branded post-meeting links info Set up a default post-meeting destination, and a list of custom post-meeting override links, to leave your viewer on the perfect page depending on meeting outcome. | check | check | enhanced |
| Remove CrankWheel branding | close | add-on | check |
| Enhanced white labeling info Add custom disclaimers and advanced branding to viewer-facing pages. Enable perfect branding of all links, not only the link your customers type to connect. It is even possible to match all prospect-facing user interfaces with your corporate branding (colors, fonts, layout). | close | add-on | available |
| Customer support | | | |
| Email and live chat support | check | check | check |
| Live online training | shared | shared | dedicated |
| Phone support | close | 8h/5d Team 300 and up | custom Up to 24/7 |
| Concierge-level onboarding | close | close | check |
| Service Level Agreement (SLA) and custom contract info We offer our standard SaaS contract, with our standard SLA, on all Enterprise plans. We also understand that it may be easier for enterprise legal teams to use their own contract, or you may require an even more stringent SLA, and both of these are available per quote for Enterprise customers. | close | close | standard or custom |
| Administrative features | | | |
| Usage reports | own | team dashboard leaderboards | team dashboard custom email reports |
| Administer user accounts | close | check | check |
| Force recording of all sessions | close | close | check |
| Restrict sharing types info You can choose which types of sharing to allow: Browser window, program window or full screen sharing. | close | close | check |
| Audit log | close | close | available |
| Advanced integrations | | | |
| API access | check | check | check |
| Zapier | check | check | check |
| Salesforce, HubSpot and more CRM connectors info CRM connectors allow launching sessions from a contact or lead, and writing back CrankWheel meeting details including a recording link. Supported CRMs include Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, HighLevel, Less Annoying CRM, Insites and several more. more details | check | check | check |
| Corporate single sign-on (SSO) | close | close | available |

##### Team Plan Pricing Options

Volume discounts apply as plans grow larger, making each included meeting less expensive. For teams where each user does a large volume of meetings, check the Busy User discount plans.

| Plan name | Price per month | Usage limits |

| Team 200 | $194 | Up to 200 meetings per month, unlimited users |
